articles.title: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
articles.snippet: State officials reported that Minnesota residents, and largely senior citizens, had lost about $1 million from scams tied to crypto kiosks from 2023 to 2025.

articles.title: Pump.fun laid off workers before they received millions in PUMP tokens: Report
articles.snippet: Pump.fun co-founder Noah Tweedale reportedly attributed the layoffs to the company growing too quickly.

articles.title: AMLBot launches AI Tracer for self-service blockchain investigations
articles.snippet: Crypto forensics company AMLBot launched an AI-enabled tool allowing users with no specialist knowledge to trace their digital assets, even after they are stolen.

articles.title: Crypto’s next altseason may have fewer winners: Wintermute
articles.snippet: Institutional investors accounted for 72% of Wintermute’s spot OTC flow in the first half of 2026 as capital clustered in fewer tokens and altcoin rallies became more selective.

articles.title: AI Music Company Suno Loses Copyright Case in Germany
articles.snippet: The decision requires AI companies to license copyrighted music used to train models and generate songs, marking another legal win for music rights holders in Europe.
